main_text.l: nomen Ecclesiæ cum veritate committát, atque intus & extra bella seuiant, & scandala exundet. Et qui in aliis cæcitatem merito improbamus, in nobis nō deprehendimus oculorū apertionē tanto indigniorem, dum nobis fere viuimus plerique, & nostra tantum quærimus, non quę Iesu Christi.

l.i: Deus superbis resistit, humilibus autem dat gratiam. Iacobi IIII.

page.notes: The vignette is a woodcut ornament of a figure between scrolls; it is not text. Faint mirrored text from the reverse page shows through the lower half and was left out. The quotation is set larger, with an enlarged initial D. The signature mark L.iij. stands below the quotation at the right. Printed "committát" carries an acute over the a, kept as printed. Long s is transcribed as plain s.
